source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the uncertainty principle with Examples 18.4-18.5 (PDF 131-133, printed 127-129).

blocks.text: Kisi particle ki position (jagah) aur momentum dono ek hi waqt mein bilkul theek theek nahi nape ja sakte. Har aisi paimaish mein ek buniyadi uncertainty (ghair-yaqeeniyat, yani kami-beshi) hamesha rehti hai. Yeh napne wale aale ki kharabi se nahi, balke maddah aur radiation ki wave-particle duality ka nateeja hai. Yeh baat pehli dafa Werner Heisenberg ne 1927 mein kahi, is liye ise Heisenberg uncertainty principle kehte hain. Rozmarra ki bari (macroscopic) cheezon ke liye yeh uncertainty bilkul na hone ke barabar hai, lekin atoms ki duniya mein yeh bohat ahem hai. Maslan udti tennis ball par photons ki dhaar pare to us ka rasta mushkil se badalta hai, lekin ek photon electron se takraye to us ki harkat bilkul badal jati hai.

Roshni wave bhi hai, is liye electron ki position sirf istemal hone wali roshni ki taqreeban ek wavelength ki durusti tak maloom ho sakti hai. Position zyada theek maloom karne ke liye chhoti wavelength ki roshni chahiye, lekin chhoti wavelength wala photon zyada momentum rakhta hai aur electron ki harkat zyada badal deta hai, is liye momentum ki paimaish kam theek ho jati hai. Agar x-axis par chalte micro-particle ki position wavelength λ ki roshni se maloom karein to position ki uncertainty:
Zyada se zyada photon apna poora momentum h/λ particle ko de sakta hai, is liye particle ke momentum ki uncertainty:

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Sub-atomic (atom se chhoti) duniya mein bohat kam cheezein 100% durusti se predict ki ja sakti hain.
In dono uncertainties ko zarb (multiply) karein:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is equation ka number (8.14) chhapti hai; sahi number 18.14 hai, jaisa agla jumla bhi kehta hai.
Equation 18.14 position-momentum uncertainty principle ki riyazi (mathematical) shakal hai. Yeh kehti hai:

blocks.title: Position-momentum uncertainty principle
blocks.text: Kisi lamhe particle ki position ki uncertainty Δx aur usi lamhe us ke momentum ke x-component ki uncertainty Δp ka hasil-e-zarb (product) taqreeban Planck's constant h ke barabar hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Seedhi baat: position jitni theek maloom karein (Δx chhota), momentum utna ghair-yaqeeni (Δp bara), kyunke dono ka product h ke barabar rehta hai. h bohat chhota hai, is liye bari cheezon mein yeh mehsoos nahi hota.

Uncertainty principle se sabit hota hai ke electrons atom ke nucleus ke andar nahi hote. Nucleus ka diameter 10⁻¹⁵ m ke qareeb hai; agar electron nucleus ke andar ho to us ki position ki uncertainty 10⁻¹⁵ m hogi. Tab momentum ki uncertainty:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is momentum ka unit 'J s' likhti hai. Momentum ka unit kg m s⁻¹ hai (J s ÷ m = kg m s⁻¹).

Is momentum ke mutabiq energy ki uncertainty GeV ke darje ki honi chahiye (E ≈ pc = 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 3 × 10⁸ ≈ 2 × 10⁻¹⁰ J, yani taqreeban 1.2 GeV). Atom mein itni energy wala koi electron nahi milta. Is liye electrons nucleus ke andar nahi hote.
Uncertainty principle ki ek aur shakal particle ki energy aur us waqt ko jodti hai jis waqt woh energy us ke paas thi:
Kitab is ke baad yeh lines likhti hai (yahan x/v waqt Δt hai, aur Δp × v energy ki uncertainty ΔE ke barabar hai):

blocks.latex: \Delta t.\Delta E \geq h \quad\text{or}\quad \Delta E.\Delta t \geq h

blocks.text: Yani particle ki energy hum jitni theek maloom karein, utna hi kam yaqeen hoga ke woh energy kitni der (kis waqt) us ke paas thi.
Heisenberg ke zyada mohtaat (careful) hisaab ke mutabiq behtareen soorat mein bhi:

blocks.text_alt: Δx.Δp ≥ ℏ   where ℏ = h/2π = 1.05 × 10⁻³⁴ J s

blocks.text: Quantum physics mein hisse ke liye Werner Heisenberg ko 1932 mein Nobel Prize mila.

blocks.title: Example 18.4
blocks.problem: Atom ke size (1.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) ke dabbe mein band electron ki velocity kitni ho sakti hai?
steps: Δp.Δx ≈ h aur Δp ≈ mΔv, is liye mΔv.Δx = h, yani Δv = h/(m × Δx)
blocks.answer: Δv = 7.3 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ (yani atom mein band electron bohat tez chal sakta hai)

blocks.title: Example 18.5
blocks.problem: Ek atom taqreeban 10⁻⁸ second tak radiation kharij karta hai. Kharij hone wale photon ki energy ki uncertainty nikalein.
steps: ΔE.Δt ≈ h, is liye ΔE ≈ h/Δt

blocks.prompt: Uncertainty principle cricket ball ke liye ghair-ahem lekin electron ke liye ahem kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke h bohat chhota hai. Bhari ball ke liye velocity ki uncertainty h/(mΔx) itni chhoti hai ke mehsoos nahi hoti, lekin atom jitni jagah mein band halke electron ke liye yeh lakhon metre fi second hai (Example 18.4).

items: Heisenberg (1927): Δx.Δp ≈ h (18.14); behtareen soorat mein Δx.Δp ≥ ℏ, ℏ = h/2π = 1.05 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.
Electrons nucleus mein nahi ho sakte; atomic duniya mein har paimaish mein uncertainty lazmi hai.
